# Project Notes

- This repository is a Node.js 18+ Express and Socket.IO WebRTC video-chat app.
- Run locally with `npm install` and `npm start`, then visit `http://localhost:3000`.
- Frontend files live in `public/`; server and matchmaking are in `server.js`.
- Never commit account data from `data/users.json` or real session secrets.
- Camera and microphone access requires `localhost` or HTTPS.
